## Overview

This document loads the Qualtrics demographics & questionnaire export, scores six validated scales, and writes a single analysis-ready CSV.

| Scale   | Items | Construct                             |
|---------|-------|---------------------------------------|
| GAD-7   | 7     | Generalised anxiety (past 2 weeks)    |
| PHQ-9   | 9     | Depression (past 2 weeks)             |
| AQ-10   | 10    | Autistic traits (screening)           |
| PAQ-24  | 24    | Alexithymia (6 subscales, 1–7 each)   |
| DAS-SF1 | 9     | Dysfunctional attitudes – Achievement |
| DAS-SF2 | 9     | Dysfunctional attitudes – Dependency  |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 1. Packages & configuration

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(psych)      # alpha()
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
```

```{r config}
find_project_root <- function() {
  # TRUE when x is a single usable string. The lookups below can return
  # character(0), and `is.na(character(0)) || ...` is an error in R >= 4.3.
  has_path <- function(x) length(x) == 1 && !is.na(x) && nzchar(x)

  # When knitting, the working directory is the Rmd's folder
  start <- tryCatch(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
  start <- if (has_path(start)) dirname(start) else NA_character_

  if (!has_path(start)) {
    start <- tryCatch({
      ctx <- rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()
      if (!is.null(ctx) && has_path(ctx$path))
        dirname(normalizePath(ctx$path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))
      else NA_character_
    }, error = function(e) NA_character_)
  }

  if (!has_path(start)) start <- getwd()

  current <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  for (i in seq_len(15)) {
    if (file.exists(file.path(current, "config.R"))) return(current)
    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (parent == current)
      stop("Could not find config.R in this directory or any parent directory.")
    current <- parent
  }
  stop("Could not find config.R after 15 levels up.")
}

project_dir <- find_project_root()
source(file.path(project_dir, "config.R"))
# QUESTIONNAIRE_DIR is now defined in config.R

OUTPUT_PATH <- file.path(COMBINED_PSYCHO_DIR, "biosignals2_questionnaires_scored.csv")
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 2. Load raw data

Qualtrics exports a 3-row header: (1) short column names, (2) full question text, (3) ImportId JSON. We use the ImportId row for unique column names, then skip all three header rows to read the data.

```{r load-raw}
# ── 2a. Find the most-recent questionnaire export ─────────────────────────────
qfiles <- list.files(
  QUESTIONNAIRE_DIR,
  pattern = "^Biosignals2.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(qfiles) == 0)
  stop("No Qualtrics CSV found in QUESTIONNAIRE_DIR: ", QUESTIONNAIRE_DIR)

if (length(qfiles) > 1) {
  qfiles <- qfiles[order(file.mtime(qfiles), decreasing = TRUE)]
  message("Multiple files found – using most recent: ", basename(qfiles[1]))
}
qfile_path <- qfiles[1]
message("Reading: ", basename(qfile_path))

# ── 2b. Parse ImportIds for unique column names ────────────────────────────────
hdr <- read_csv(
  qfile_path,
  n_max        = 3,
  col_names    = FALSE,
  col_types    = cols(.default = "c"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

import_ids_raw <- as.character(hdr[3, ])
import_ids     <- str_extract(import_ids_raw, '(?<="ImportId":")[^"]+')
row1_names     <- as.character(hdr[1, ])

# Fall back to (de-duplicated) row-1 names when ImportId can't be parsed
col_names_final <- if_else(
  !is.na(import_ids),
  import_ids,
  make.unique(row1_names, sep = "_x")
)

# ── 2c. Read data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df_raw <- read_csv(
  qfile_path,
  skip           = 3,
  col_names      = col_names_final,
  col_types      = cols(.default = "c"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

cat("Rows loaded:", nrow(df_raw), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(df_raw), "\n")
```

## 3. Inspect & filter

```{r inspect}
# Completion summary
df_raw |>
  count(finished, progress = as.integer(progress)) |>
  arrange(desc(progress)) |>
  kable(caption = "Response completion status") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r filter}
# Keep only completed responses (Finished == TRUE, Progress == 100)
# A "labels" export writes Finished as TRUE/FALSE; a "values" export writes 1/0.
df_complete <- df_raw |>
  filter(
    str_to_upper(finished) %in% c("TRUE", "1"),
    as.integer(progress)   == 100
  )

cat(nrow(df_complete), "complete responses retained out of", nrow(df_raw), "total.\n")
```

```{r pid-clean}
# ── Participant ID ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Column ImportId: QID7_1
df <- df_complete |>
  rename(participant_id = QID7_1) |>
  mutate(participant_id = str_squish(str_to_upper(participant_id)))

# Flag duplicates
dup_ids <- df |> count(participant_id) |> filter(n > 1)
if (nrow(dup_ids) > 0) {
  message("WARNING: duplicate participant IDs found:")
  print(dup_ids)
}

cat("Unique participant IDs:", n_distinct(df$participant_id), "\n")
```

## 4. Demographics

```{r demographics}
# A Qualtrics "values" export writes the choice code rather than the choice text
# for these single-answer questions, so restore the labels here.
#
# ⚠️  Only the codes actually observed in the pilot data have been verified
# (by comparing against the earlier label-style export). Any other code is left
# visible as "code <n>" rather than silently mislabelled — if one appears, look
# it up in the Qualtrics codebook and add it below.
sex_map       <- c("0" = "Male", "1" = "Female")
gender_map    <- c("1" = "Yes")
ethnicity_map <- c("1" = "Asian (any background)",
                   "2" = "Black (any background)",
                   "3" = "Mixed (any background)",
                   "4" = "White (any background)")

relabel <- function(x, map) {
  x   <- str_squish(as.character(x))
  out <- unname(map[match(x, names(map))])
  # Leave real text (a labels export) alone; mark unknown numeric codes.
  is_num <- !is.na(x) & x != "" & str_detect(x, "^-?\\d+$")
  out[is.na(out) & is_num] <- paste0("code ", x[is.na(out) & is_num])
  out[is.na(out) & !is_num] <- x[is.na(out) & !is_num]
  out
}

demo <- df |>
  transmute(
    participant_id,
    age          = as.integer(QID1_TEXT),
    sex_at_birth = relabel(QID3, sex_map),
    gender_id    = relabel(QID4, gender_map),
    ethnicity    = relabel(QID5, ethnicity_map)
  )

# Age
cat("Age  — mean:", round(mean(demo$age, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    "  SD:", round(sd(demo$age, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    "  range:", min(demo$age, na.rm = TRUE), "–", max(demo$age, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# Sex
demo |> count(sex_at_birth) |>
  kable(caption = "Biological sex at birth") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r ethnicity-table}
demo |> count(ethnicity) |>
  kable(caption = "Race/ethnicity") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

## 5. Response-recoding helpers

```{r recode-helpers}
# ── Likert maps ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

gad7_map <- c(
  "Not at all"                   = 0,
  "Several days"                 = 1,
  "More than half the days"      = 2,
  "Nearly every day"             = 3
)

phq9_map <- c(
  "Not at all"                      = 0,
  "Several days"                    = 1,
  "More than half of the days"      = 2,
  "Nearly every day"                = 3
)

aq_agree_map    <- c("Definitely agree" = 1, "Slightly agree"    = 1,
                     "Slightly disagree" = 0, "Definitely disagree" = 0)
aq_disagree_map <- c("Definitely agree" = 0, "Slightly agree"    = 0,
                     "Slightly disagree" = 1, "Definitely disagree" = 1)

# AQ-10 is the one scale whose exported value is NOT the score: a values export
# writes the choice position (1 = Definitely agree … 4 = Definitely disagree),
# which still has to be collapsed to the 0/1 AQ-10 scoring.
aq_agree_valmap    <- c("1" = 1, "2" = 1, "3" = 0, "4" = 0)
aq_disagree_valmap <- c("1" = 0, "2" = 0, "3" = 1, "4" = 1)

# PAQ-24 is a 7-point scale (1 = strongly disagree … 7 = strongly agree).
# In the survey only the anchors and a few midpoints carry text labels, so a
# "labels" export writes "---" for the unlabelled points and the item can never
# be scored from text alone — export as values. This map is kept only so older
# label-style exports still partially resolve.
paq_map <- c(
  "Strongly disagree"            = 1,
  "Disagree"                     = 2,
  "Slightly disagree"            = 3,
  "Neither agree nor disagree"   = 4,
  "Slightly agree"               = 5,
  "Agree"                        = 6,
  "Strongly agree"               = 7,
  "---"                          = NA_real_   # unlabelled scale point
)

# DAS-SF: 7-point scale. All items are dysfunctionally worded EXCEPT
# DAS-SF2 item 12 ("I do not need the approval of other people...").
# Convention used here: Totally Agree = 7 (most dysfunctional) →
# Totally Disagree = 1 (least dysfunctional).
# ⚠️  Verify this direction against your scoring key.
das_map <- c(
  "Totally Agree"     = 7,
  "Agree"             = 6,
  "Slightly Agree"    = 5,
  "Neutral"           = 4,
  "Slightly Disagree" = 3,
  "Disagree"          = 2,
  "Totally Disagree"  = 1
)

# Qualtrics can export a question either as choice TEXT ("Not at all") or as the
# numeric recode VALUE ("0"), and this project has used both. recode_numeric()
# accepts either:
#   * text entries are matched against `map`, case- and whitespace-insensitively
#     (Qualtrics exports e.g. "Definitely Agree", and an exact-match lookup would
#     silently turn every such response into NA);
#   * purely numeric entries are translated by `num_map`, a named lookup from the
#     exported value to the score. num_map = NULL means the exported value IS the
#     score (true for GAD-7, PHQ-9, PAQ-24 and DAS-SF, but NOT for AQ-10).
# Blanks and Qualtrics' "---" (an unlabelled scale point) stay NA either way.
recode_numeric <- function(x, map, num_map = NULL) {
  x   <- str_squish(as.character(x))
  out <- unname(map[match(str_to_lower(x), str_to_lower(names(map)))])

  is_num <- !is.na(x) & x != "" & str_detect(x, "^-?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?$")
  if (any(is_num)) {
    out[is_num] <- if (is.null(num_map)) {
      as.numeric(x[is_num])
    } else {
      unname(num_map[match(x[is_num], names(num_map))])
    }
  }
  out
}

# Cronbach's alpha that returns NA (instead of stopping the knit) when a scale
# has too few answered items or complete responses to estimate it.
safe_alpha <- function(items) {
  items <- items[, colSums(!is.na(items)) > 0, drop = FALSE]
  if (ncol(items) < 2 || sum(complete.cases(items)) < 3) return(NA_real_)
  tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(psych::alpha(items, warnings = FALSE)$total$raw_alpha),
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
}
```

## 6. GAD-7

Items: QID8_1 – QID8_7 (0 = Not at all … 3 = Nearly every day) Total: 0–21 \| Clinical flag: ≥ 10

```{r gad7}
gad7_cols <- paste0("QID8_", 1:7)

gad7 <- df |>
  select(participant_id, all_of(gad7_cols)) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(gad7_cols),
                \(x) recode_numeric(x, gad7_map))) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    gad7_total    = sum(c_across(all_of(gad7_cols)), na.rm = FALSE),
    gad7_n_missing = sum(is.na(c_across(all_of(gad7_cols)))),
    gad7_severity = case_when(
      gad7_total <= 4  ~ "Minimal",
      gad7_total <= 9  ~ "Mild",
      gad7_total <= 14 ~ "Moderate",
      TRUE             ~ "Severe"
    ),
    gad7_flag = gad7_total >= 10
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# Descriptives
gad7 |>
  summarise(
    n        = sum(!is.na(gad7_total)),
    mean     = round(mean(gad7_total, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    sd       = round(sd(gad7_total, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    min      = min(gad7_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    max      = max(gad7_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_flagged = sum(gad7_flag, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "GAD-7 descriptives (total score 0–21; flagged ≥ 10)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r gad7-severity}
gad7 |> count(gad7_severity) |>
  kable(caption = "GAD-7 severity distribution") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r gad7-alpha}
gad7_items <- gad7 |> select(all_of(gad7_cols))
cat("GAD-7 Cronbach's α =",
    round(safe_alpha(gad7_items), 3), "\n")
```

## 7. PHQ-9

Items: QID10_1–QID10_5 (first 5), QID32_6–QID32_9 (last 4) Total: 0–27 \| Clinical flag: ≥ 10 \| Item 9 (suicidal ideation) flagged separately

```{r phq9}
phq9_cols <- c(paste0("QID10_", 1:5), paste0("QID32_", 6:9))

phq9 <- df |>
  select(participant_id, all_of(phq9_cols)) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(phq9_cols),
                \(x) recode_numeric(x, phq9_map))) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    phq9_total     = sum(c_across(all_of(phq9_cols)), na.rm = FALSE),
    phq9_n_missing = sum(is.na(c_across(all_of(phq9_cols)))),
    phq9_severity  = case_when(
      phq9_total <= 4  ~ "Minimal",
      phq9_total <= 9  ~ "Mild",
      phq9_total <= 14 ~ "Moderate",
      phq9_total <= 19 ~ "Moderately severe",
      TRUE             ~ "Severe"
    ),
    phq9_flag          = phq9_total >= 10,
    phq9_item9_flagged = QID32_9 >= 1  # suicidal ideation item
  ) |>
  ungroup()

phq9 |>
  summarise(
    n         = sum(!is.na(phq9_total)),
    mean      = round(mean(phq9_total, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    sd        = round(sd(phq9_total, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    min       = min(phq9_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    max       = max(phq9_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_flagged = sum(phq9_flag, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_item9   = sum(phq9_item9_flagged, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "PHQ-9 descriptives (total 0–27; flagged ≥ 10; n_item9 = any suicidal ideation)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r phq9-severity}
phq9 |> count(phq9_severity) |>
  kable(caption = "PHQ-9 severity distribution") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r phq9-alpha}
phq9_items <- phq9 |> select(all_of(phq9_cols))
cat("PHQ-9 Cronbach's α =",
    round(safe_alpha(phq9_items), 3), "\n")
```

## 8. AQ-10

Items: QID42 sub-items (10 items in order of appearance) Scoring: items 1, 7, 8, 10 → agree = 1; items 2–6, 9 → disagree = 1 Total: 0–10 \| Possible autism flag: ≥ 6

```{r aq10}
# Sub-IDs in Qualtrics don't always match item numbers; we use positional order.
aq10_cols <- c("QID42_1","QID42_3","QID42_6","QID42_8","QID42_9",
               "QID42_10","QID42_11","QID42_12","QID42_13","QID42_14")

# AQ-10 standard scoring direction (Allison et al., 2012):
# Forward (agree = autistic trait): positions 1, 7, 8, 10
# Reverse (disagree = autistic trait): positions 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9
aq_forward_pos  <- c(1, 7, 8, 10)
aq_reverse_pos  <- c(2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9)

aq10 <- df |>
  select(participant_id, all_of(aq10_cols)) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(aq10_cols[aq_forward_pos]),
      \(x) recode_numeric(x, aq_agree_map, aq_agree_valmap)
    ),
    across(
      all_of(aq10_cols[aq_reverse_pos]),
      \(x) recode_numeric(x, aq_disagree_map, aq_disagree_valmap)
    )
  ) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    aq10_total     = sum(c_across(all_of(aq10_cols)), na.rm = FALSE),
    aq10_n_missing = sum(is.na(c_across(all_of(aq10_cols)))),
    aq10_flag      = aq10_total >= 6
  ) |>
  ungroup()

aq10 |>
  summarise(
    n         = sum(!is.na(aq10_total)),
    mean      = round(mean(aq10_total, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    sd        = round(sd(aq10_total, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    min       = min(aq10_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    max       = max(aq10_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_flagged = sum(aq10_flag, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "AQ-10 descriptives (total 0–10; flagged ≥ 6)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r aq10-alpha}
aq10_items <- aq10 |> select(all_of(aq10_cols))
cat("AQ-10 Cronbach's α =",
    round(safe_alpha(aq10_items), 3), "\n")
```

## 9. PAQ-24

24 items across 6 QID blocks (4 items each). All items scored 1–7 (higher = more alexithymia). No reverse-scored items. Each subscale: 4–28 \| Total: 24–168.

**⚠ Subscale assignment below is inferred from item content and Qualtrics block order. Verify against the Qualtrics survey builder.**

Subscales (Preece et al., 2018): - **DIF-N** — Difficulty Identifying Feelings (Negative affect) - **DDF-N** — Difficulty Describing Feelings (Negative affect) - **IN-N** — Inattention to Emotions (Negative affect) - **DIF-P** — Difficulty Identifying Feelings (Positive affect) - **DDF-P** — Difficulty Describing Feelings (Positive affect) - **IN-P** — Inattention to Emotions (Positive affect)

```{r paq24-cols}
# ── Column assignments (verify against your Qualtrics survey) ─────────────────
paq_DIF_N <- c("QID43_1",  "QID43_3",  "QID44_28", "QID44_29")
paq_DDF_N <- c("QID43_6",  "QID43_8",  "QID44_13", "QID44_14")
paq_IN_N  <- c("QID51_9",  "QID51_27", "QID51_28", "QID51_10")
paq_DIF_P <- c("QID52_28", "QID52_29", "QID53_23", "QID53_24")
paq_DDF_P <- c("QID52_17", "QID52_18", "QID53_25", "QID53_26")
paq_IN_P  <- c("QID45_19", "QID45_20", "QID45_21", "QID45_22")

paq_all_cols <- c(paq_DIF_N, paq_DDF_N, paq_IN_N, paq_DIF_P, paq_DDF_P, paq_IN_P)
```

```{r paq24-score}
paq24 <- df |>
  select(participant_id, all_of(paq_all_cols)) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(paq_all_cols), \(x) recode_numeric(x, paq_map))) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    paq_DIF_N      = sum(c_across(all_of(paq_DIF_N)), na.rm = FALSE),
    paq_DDF_N      = sum(c_across(all_of(paq_DDF_N)), na.rm = FALSE),
    paq_IN_N       = sum(c_across(all_of(paq_IN_N)),  na.rm = FALSE),
    paq_DIF_P      = sum(c_across(all_of(paq_DIF_P)), na.rm = FALSE),
    paq_DDF_P      = sum(c_across(all_of(paq_DDF_P)), na.rm = FALSE),
    paq_IN_P       = sum(c_across(all_of(paq_IN_P)),  na.rm = FALSE),
    paq_total      = sum(c_across(all_of(paq_all_cols)), na.rm = FALSE),
    paq_n_missing  = sum(is.na(c_across(all_of(paq_all_cols))))
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# Remove raw item columns from scored output
paq24_scores <- paq24 |> select(participant_id, starts_with("paq_"))

# Descriptives per subscale
paq24_scores |>
  select(-participant_id, -paq_n_missing) |>
  summarise(across(everything(),
                   list(mean = \(x) round(mean(x, na.rm=TRUE), 2),
                        sd   = \(x) round(sd(x, na.rm=TRUE), 2)),
                   .names = "{.col}__{.fn}")) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = c("subscale", "stat"), names_sep = "__") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) |>
  kable(caption = "PAQ-24 subscale descriptives (each subscale: 4–28; total: 24–168)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r paq24-alpha}
subscale_list <- list(
  DIF_N = paq_DIF_N, DDF_N = paq_DDF_N, IN_N = paq_IN_N,
  DIF_P = paq_DIF_P, DDF_P = paq_DDF_P, IN_P  = paq_IN_P
)

paq_items_raw <- df |>
  select(all_of(paq_all_cols)) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), \(x) recode_numeric(x, paq_map)))

alpha_table <- imap_dfr(subscale_list, function(cols, name) {
  items <- paq_items_raw |> select(all_of(cols))
  tibble(
    subscale = name,
    alpha    = round(safe_alpha(items), 3),
    n_items  = ncol(items)
  )
})

alpha_table |>
  kable(caption = "PAQ-24 Cronbach's α per subscale") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

cat("PAQ-24 total (all 24 items) α =",
    round(safe_alpha(paq_items_raw), 3), "\n")
```

## 10. DAS-SF1 (Achievement)

9 items (QID59). Responses: 1 (Totally Disagree) – 7 (Totally Agree). All items dysfunctionally worded → higher score = more dysfunctional. Total range: 9–63.

```{r das-sf1}
das1_cols <- c("QID59_23","QID59_27","QID59_28","QID59_29",
               "QID59_24","QID59_25","QID59_26","QID59_32","QID59_33")

das_sf1 <- df |>
  select(participant_id, all_of(das1_cols)) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(das1_cols), \(x) recode_numeric(x, das_map))) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    das_sf1_total     = sum(c_across(all_of(das1_cols)), na.rm = FALSE),
    das_sf1_n_missing = sum(is.na(c_across(all_of(das1_cols))))
  ) |>
  ungroup()

das_sf1 |>
  summarise(
    n    = sum(!is.na(das_sf1_total)),
    mean = round(mean(das_sf1_total, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    sd   = round(sd(das_sf1_total, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    min  = min(das_sf1_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    max  = max(das_sf1_total, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "DAS-SF1 Achievement descriptives (total 9–63)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r das-sf1-alpha}
das1_items <- das_sf1 |> select(all_of(das1_cols))
cat("DAS-SF1 Cronbach's α =",
    round(safe_alpha(das1_items), 3), "\n")
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 11. DAS-SF2 (Dependency)

9 items (QID60). Same 7-point response scale. **Note:** Item "I do not need the approval of other people in order to be happy" is positively worded and is reverse-scored (8 − raw) before summing. Identify this item's ImportId in the column list below and set `das2_reverse_col` accordingly.

```{r das-sf2}
das2_cols <- c("QID60_23","QID60_27","QID60_28","QID60_29",
               "QID60_24","QID60_25","QID60_26","QID60_32","QID60_33")

# ⚠️  Set this to the ImportId of the "I do not need approval" item.
# Inspect `names(df)` alongside the Qualtrics question order to confirm.
das2_reverse_col <- "QID60_25"   # placeholder — VERIFY

das_sf2 <- df |>
  select(participant_id, all_of(das2_cols)) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(das2_cols), \(x) recode_numeric(x, das_map))) |>
  # Reverse the positive item
  mutate(across(all_of(das2_reverse_col), \(x) 8 - x)) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    das_sf2_total     = sum(c_across(all_of(das2_cols)), na.rm = FALSE),
    das_sf2_n_missing = sum(is.na(c_across(all_of(das2_cols))))
  ) |>
  ungroup()

das_sf2 |>
  summarise(
    n    = sum(!is.na(das_sf2_total)),
    mean = round(mean(das_sf2_total, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    sd   = round(sd(das_sf2_total, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    min  = min(das_sf2_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    max  = max(das_sf2_total, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "DAS-SF2 Dependency descriptives (total 9–63)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r das-sf2-alpha}
das2_items <- das_sf2 |> select(all_of(das2_cols))
cat("DAS-SF2 Cronbach's α =",
    round(safe_alpha(das2_items), 3), "\n")
```

## 12. Clinical flags summary

```{r clinical-flags}
flags <- df |>
  select(participant_id) |>
  left_join(gad7  |> select(participant_id, gad7_total,  gad7_flag),  by = "participant_id") |>
  left_join(phq9  |> select(participant_id, phq9_total,  phq9_flag, phq9_item9_flagged),
            by = "participant_id") |>
  left_join(aq10  |> select(participant_id, aq10_total,  aq10_flag),  by = "participant_id")

flags |>
  summarise(
    `GAD-7 ≥ 10 (possible GAD)`      = sum(gad7_flag, na.rm = TRUE),
    `PHQ-9 ≥ 10 (possible depression)` = sum(phq9_flag, na.rm = TRUE),
    `PHQ-9 item 9 ≥ 1 (suicidal ideation)` = sum(phq9_item9_flagged, na.rm = TRUE),
    `AQ-10 ≥ 6 (possible autism)`    = sum(aq10_flag, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Flag", values_to = "n participants") |>
  kable(caption = "Clinical screening flags") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

## 13. Scale-score correlations

```{r correlations}
scale_scores <- df |>
  select(participant_id) |>
  left_join(gad7     |> select(participant_id, gad7_total),  by = "participant_id") |>
  left_join(phq9     |> select(participant_id, phq9_total),  by = "participant_id") |>
  left_join(aq10     |> select(participant_id, aq10_total),  by = "participant_id") |>
  left_join(paq24_scores |> select(participant_id, paq_total),by = "participant_id") |>
  left_join(das_sf1  |> select(participant_id, das_sf1_total),by = "participant_id")|>
  left_join(das_sf2  |> select(participant_id, das_sf2_total),by = "participant_id")

cor_mat <- scale_scores |>
  select(-participant_id) |>
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs") |>
  round(2)

cor_mat |>
  kable(caption = "Pearson correlations between scale totals") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

## 14. Export scored dataset

```{r export}
scored_out <- demo |>
  left_join(gad7  |> select(participant_id, gad7_total, gad7_severity, gad7_flag, gad7_n_missing),
            by = "participant_id") |>
  left_join(phq9  |> select(participant_id, phq9_total, phq9_severity, phq9_flag,
                              phq9_item9_flagged, phq9_n_missing),
            by = "participant_id") |>
  left_join(aq10  |> select(participant_id, aq10_total, aq10_flag, aq10_n_missing),
            by = "participant_id") |>
  left_join(paq24_scores,  by = "participant_id") |>
  left_join(das_sf1 |> select(participant_id, das_sf1_total, das_sf1_n_missing),
            by = "participant_id") |>
  left_join(das_sf2 |> select(participant_id, das_sf2_total, das_sf2_n_missing),
            by = "participant_id")

write_csv(scored_out, OUTPUT_PATH)
cat("Scored dataset written to:\n", OUTPUT_PATH, "\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(scored_out), "  Columns:", ncol(scored_out), "\n")

glimpse(scored_out)
```
